study type: secondary analysis of an observational cohort study
exposure: continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) metrics (mean glucose, standard deviation, time in/below/above glucose target range, mean amplitude of glycemic excursion, high/low glucose indices, coefficient variation)
cohort: The study included 185 pregnant Swedish women with type 1 diabetes undergoing continuous glucose monitoring throughout pregnancy.
finding: Pregnant women with type 1 diabetes did not differ in glycemic control or pregnancy outcome, related to either multiple daily injections or insulin pump administration.
